name: gradient-outline-type
title: Gradient Outline Type
description: Display text rendered as a gradient stroke with a transparent fill, layered twice — a wide soft pass under a crisp narrow pass — so the outline reads as an object rather than a filter.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Brutalist
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: Duotone

## Rules

- Static: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
